title: Фокус с чесноком и возвращение Шефа  (The Garlic Trick and the Chef's Return)

segments.t: In the middle of the dining room, Max charms the Chinese tour group by demonstrating how to crush and peel garlic cloves by shaking them vigorously between two bowls. When Chef Barinov suddenly returns and starts yelling at Max, the interpreter calmly turns his outburst into polite commentary.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'But first I am going to show all of you.' Max anchors the line on 'but', while 'for you' completes the thought.
'And we start pressing down with the palm of the hand.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'both' before landing on 'pressure'. Max answers right away.
'With a knife we trim off the ends of the garlic.' The grammar packs 'small knife' and 'garlic' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Now we take a mixing bowl.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'we take' and finishing on 'bowl'.
'We place this garlic right inside it.' Max brings out the contrast between 'to put' and 'there' in a few short words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'We take a second bowl.' The meaning hinges on 'we take' working together with 'bowl' in spoken Russian.
'And we shake it hard.' Notice how Russian expresses 'both' and 'to shake' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'The garlic is completely peeled.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'garlic', while 'peeled' completes the thought. Max answers right away.
'Alright, there is no need to translate that part.' The meaning hinges on 'like this' working together with 'at' in spoken Russian.
'Vitya, do not yell in here.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'Vitya', while 'to yell' completes the thought.
'You are the one we should be asking about that.' The grammar packs 'this' and 'to ask' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'There is no need to translate that part either.' The grammar packs 'this' and 'at' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Wonderful snails.' Max brings out the contrast between 'wonderful' and 'snail' in a few short words. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
When you watch Scene 14 of Episode 18, listen out for the exchange around the garlic trick and the chef's return — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
